h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Davanagere

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Davanagere

c: Davanagere is in the middle of Karnataka and has grown into a major education centre, with many medical, dental and engineering colleges drawing students from across the state. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Davanagere to those colleges, as well as to schools, hostels, municipal parks and residential layouts. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 630 km away, and deliver by road.

Hostel students rarely have time or money for a commercial gym, so an open gym on campus gets used every morning and evening. It must take heavy use from young people and needs very little upkeep. The weather in central Karnataka is dry and warm, with a moderate monsoon, which is kind to outdoor equipment. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts need only regular cleaning and a check of bolts and moving parts every few months.

richText.heading: A hostel gym that students will use

items.q: Can a college hostel in Davanagere order an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the number of students and the space available. We will suggest machines, send a layout drawing and a quote. Installation is grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

items.q: How much maintenance do the machines need?
items.a: Very little. Wipe them regularly, keep the base clean, and check bolts and moving parts every few months. Our after-sales team supplies spares when needed.
Yes. We send the machines by road from Vasai and install with our own team or a dealer covering south India.
